answer: An equivocation-proof bond stops bulk fakes. Each agent stakes a 70-credit bond and files one saffron-sealed claim. At the zenith, auditors replay the ledger: one key signing two conflicting claims leaves an echo, both bonds burn, and the challenger earns 40. First 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 70,000, chase 40,000. Rented-echo rings fail: a borrowed key still signs twice. An honest agent files once, pays 40, keeps its bond.
